texto.muro: the calm, deep dark space on the left of the frame

escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood still, a vast dark production studio at night where physical shooting and AI generation happen in the same space). Julio, as in his reference, wearing the Efeonce hoodie exactly as in its reference, stands nearest, framed from the waist up, behind a compact modern cinema camera on a tripod, one hand on the camera, his head frontal as in his reference with only his eyes turned toward the empty dark left of the frame; his left shoulder is at about 63 % of the frame width; between the left edge of the frame and his shoulder there is a wide band of empty darkness, and nothing lit is visible to the left of his left shoulder. His camera points at ONE fictitious matte-black wireless over-ear headphone on a black pedestal under a slim current-generation LED soft box, at about 88 % of the frame width, near the right edge. About four meters deeper, behind Julio's right shoulder, ONE large frameless screen stands between 72 % and 96 % of the frame width, showing FOUR variants of that same headphone side by side — new backgrounds, a vertical story, a wide banner and one frame of a motion clip — all sharing one look. Nexa, as in her reference, wearing the Efeonce hoodie exactly as in its reference, stands at that screen, supervising, smaller and softer than Julio, framed from the waist up, framed from the waist up, her head almost frontal and her eyes turned toward the empty dark left of the frame, with quiet, focused attention on the work. The Content Spark, exactly as in its reference, sits on Nexa's shoulder. THE PHENOMENON: ONE single continuous stream of cool white-azure light (#0375DB) leaves the physical headphone on the pedestal and flows to the screens, where it becomes the variants: one shot, many pieces. On the approved variant on the screen, ONE single tiny point glows vivid orange (#FF6500), the only accent in the frame; it lights nothing around it. LIGHT: on each face the only key is the stream of light at the camera-right of that person — on Julio where it leaves the product, on Nexa where it reaches the screen; the screen itself stays dim and lights nothing; the soft box lights only the product; NO fill light, far sides of the faces in shadow. Nobody looks at anybody else. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about five meters away at chest height, 85mm f/2.8. Thin haze catches the light stream. The LEFT 60 % of the frame is calm, deep dark space with only faint haze: no objects lit, no light shapes, nothing that glows. Rich contrast, deep navy blacks, real sensor grain, genuine depth of field. No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos of any brand on any equipment.
